name: finish
description: End your task. Call this once the acceptance criteria are met or when you cannot make further progress. The summary is shown to the lead and the owner.

summary.description: Two lines: what was done and what is left.

ok.description: false when the task could not be completed.

name: note
description: Write a short private note to yourself. Use it to keep a plan or a finding across steps without calling another tool.

name: ask_human
description: Ask the owner a question when you are blocked on a decision you cannot make yourself. The run pauses for you until the owner answers.

name: recall
description: Search the crew's lessons and saved skills for guidance relevant to what you are doing now. Returns at most five short entries.

name: record_lesson
description: Record a lesson learned during this task so future agents avoid the same mistake. Keep it general and actionable, never include secrets.

text.description: The lesson in one or two sentences.

name: save_skill
description: Save a successful multi-step procedure as a named, parameterized skill that you or other agents can reuse later.

name: handoff
description: Hand part of your task to another role. Creates a child task with your spec and acceptance criteria; you wait for its result summary.

context.description: What the other agent must know.

name: create_tasks
description: Create up to 12 tasks for the crew from the goal. Each task has one owner role, a spec, acceptance criteria and dependencies on other tasks by index.

name: update_task
description: Change a task you created: its spec, acceptance criteria, priority, or cancel it when it is no longer needed.

name: list_tasks
description: List the tasks of this run with their status, owner and result summary. Filter by status to keep the output short.

name: crew_status
description: Show every agent of this run with its role, status, current task and token usage so far.

name: fs_list
description: List files and folders in the workspace. Returns paths relative to the workspace root with sizes. Use depth to limit the listing.

path.description: Folder to list, default the root.

name: fs_read
description: Read a text file from the workspace. Prefer a line range for large files. Reading an unchanged file again returns a short pointer instead of the content.

name: fs_search
description: Search file contents in the workspace with a regular expression. Returns matching lines with path and line number, capped by limit.

glob.description: Optional path glob, for example src/**/*.ts

name: fs_write
description: Create a new file or replace a small file in the workspace. For changes to existing files prefer fs_edit.

name: fs_edit
description: Edit a file by exact find and replace. The find text must match exactly once unless all is true. Returns the number of replacements.

name: fs_delete
description: Delete a file inside the workspace. Folders are not deleted. The owner may be asked to confirm.

name: shell_run
description: Run a shell command in the workspace (sandboxed, scrubbed env, no network unless allowed). Returns exit code, stdout and stderr, truncated head and tail.

name: web_fetch
description: Fetch a public web page and return its readable text. Needs network consent. Long pages are truncated head and tail.

name: web_search
description: Search the web and return titles, urls and short snippets for the top results. Needs network consent.

name: generate_image
description: Generate an image with the owner's image model and save it under assets/ in the workspace. Returns the asset path and size.

name: generate_video
description: Start a short video generation with the owner's video model. Returns a queued asset id; the file lands under assets/ when done.

name: scan_deps
description: Audit the project's lockfiles against the OSV database. Sends only package names and versions, needs network consent. Returns findings with severity.

paths.description: Lockfiles to scan, default all found.

name: scan_secrets
description: Scan the workspace for committed secrets with pattern and entropy rules. Values are always masked in the output.

name: scan_config
description: Review Dockerfiles, compose files, CORS, cookie and debug settings, and committed env files for insecure configuration.

name: submit_review
description: Submit your review of the change. Approve, or request changes with located notes; each note becomes a fix item for the owner of the task.

name: report_issue
description: Report a bug or a security finding with evidence. It is graded and can become a fix task for the right role.

name: screen_capture
description: Take a screenshot of the main display or one window. Needs the screen capability; the owner sees an indicator while it is active.

window.description: App or window title, default the whole display.

name: ui_tree
description: Read the accessibility tree of the focused app or a named app, with roles, labels and frames of the elements.

name: pointer
description: Move the pointer, click or scroll at screen coordinates or on an accessibility element. Mutating actions ask the owner in ask mode.

name: keyboard
description: Type text or press a key combination in the focused app. Refused while secure text input is active.

name: app_open
description: Open, activate or quit an application on the owner's Mac by name or bundle id.

name: browser_open
description: Open a url in the owner's default browser and optionally return the page's readable text once loaded.
